- [x] I, the PR author, have personally reviewed every line of this PR.

# What does this PR do?

Extend opt-in `gdn_core_attn` activation offloading to GDN2 and Transformer Engine CUDA graphs for GDN/GDN2 training.

Reuse the existing recurrence scope, differentiable prefetch anchor, commit before output normalization, transfer streams and pinned-memory pool. Keep TE layer-graph replay on the caller's autograd stream to preserve ordering with shared graph pools. Native pre-GDR kernels and autotuning are unchanged.

GDN2 keeps sigmoid gate outputs resident when gate backward already retains their storage: the differentiable write gate, and the differentiable erase gate without head expansion. Expanded erase gates and frozen gates remain eligible for offload. This avoids transfers that cannot free the original GPU storage.

Support is BF16/FLA only: attention/whole-layer TE capture, `gdn_norm_out` recomputation and delayed offload. Graph offload requires PyTorch >= 2.9, TE >= 2.14 and positive graph warmup. Set `NVTE_CPU_OFFLOAD_V1=1` before launch. GDN2 requires `fla.ops.gdn2`. FP8/FP4, full recomputation and local/full-iteration graphs are unsupported. See [usage and configuration](https://github.com/Pinoeer-kingxi/Megatron-LM/blob/1f6eab9ce2453cf55cfeac57add2ed80540f31a7/docs/developer/gdn_activation_offloading.md).

## Dependencies

Requires #7908 and its #8243 prerequisite. The diff against `main` includes both; the [extension diff](https://github.com/Pinoeer-kingxi/Megatron-LM/compare/485cb5fa2ffedaaaa0a1a4d095e43ddd99487c1d...1f6eab9ce2453cf55cfeac57add2ed80540f31a7) isolates the additional changes. #8244 is independent. Composition with #7852 is not validated.

## Validation

Head: `1f6eab9ce2453cf55cfeac57add2ed80540f31a7`. GPU source: `367d014c7bf74ba3553c9db58da47fa5bcba906e`. Only documentation differs; the complete production, test and tool trees are identical ([tree comparison](https://github.com/Pinoeer-kingxi/Megatron-LM/blob/95ba13de41c85950511bfdb7bb481df2235d1d57/gdn-graph-profile-20261017/final-source-qualification.json)). Environment: RTX A6000, PyTorch 2.11.0+cu130, TE 2.20.2, FLA 0.5.1 and Triton 3.6.0.

- Each of two ranks passes 20 scope cases, 18 native GDN2 training cases and 9 real TE graph cases, with zero skips. Coverage includes DP2, TP2+SP, PP2, norm recomputation, fractions 0/0.5/1, attention/whole-layer capture and delayed offload. Regressions check actual gate-copy selection, equal/expanded heads, trainable/frozen gates, all gradients and evaluation with gradients.
- Complete eight-block GDN2 model comparisons at linear key/value heads 8/16 and 16/16 match all six optimizer steps, including three graph replays: losses, gradient norms, complete gradients, weights and Adam/master-state fingerprints are exact. Pinned-buffer ownership is zero before resets, and allocation counters stay constant during replay.
- Three fresh-process performance pairs match all 16 input hashes, losses and gradient norms. Separate Nsight runs check actual transfers and kernel counts; profiler timings are excluded from the performance results. Black, isort, Ruff, project Pylint and kernel determinism coverage checks pass.

[Commands, rank logs, state comparisons, traces and samples](https://github.com/Pinoeer-kingxi/Megatron-LM/tree/95ba13de41c85950511bfdb7bb481df2235d1d57/gdn-graph-profile-20261017) are public.

Earlier [two-rank matrices](https://github.com/Pinoeer-kingxi/Megatron-LM/tree/34371ca51fa2dffb5c362f1c52c89b1801670226/gdn-followup-20261016) and [complete Qwen/GDN2 graph-training checks](https://github.com/Pinoeer-kingxi/Megatron-LM/tree/6518374eafc6b64358c1cecb805dc845c4b2ec4a/gdn-graph-training-20261017) include 21 GDN/GDN2 graph cases per rank and full pretrained Qwen3.5-0.8B text-state comparisons. They retain their original revisions and predate the gate-selection change.

## Memory and runtime

The before/after comparison trains the complete eight-block GDN2/attention model: hidden size 1024, vocabulary 4096, linear key/value heads 8/16, head dimension 128, embeddings, MLPs, vocabulary loss and native BF16 Adam. Both arms enable offloading and whole-layer TE graphs on one A6000, with sequence 2048, four microbatches, unfused pre-GDR, norm recomputation off, fraction 1 and the default 1,048,576-element threshold.

Three fresh-process pairs alternate arm order. Each arm trains three native steps, captures graphs, warms up three replay steps and times ten optimizer steps. Timing includes zeroing, forward/backward/finalization, eager Adam and CUDA completion; inputs, capture and snapshots are excluded.

| Metric | Before, `d18040ba5a` | After, `367d014c7b` |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Median of process-median step times | 451.71 ms | 424.91 ms |
| Median peak reserved | 4944 MiB | 4922 MiB |
| D2H and H2D bytes per step, combined | 3200 MiB | 2880 MiB |
| Retained pinned buffers | 54 | 48 |

Paired median step time falls 5.93% (5.89–5.95%); additional reserved savings are 22 MiB (20–38 MiB), with unchanged allocated peaks. Nsight records 10% fewer transfer bytes and unchanged kernel name/count multisets. This measures the gate-selection change with offloading enabled in both arms. Transfer overhead remains substantial.

Historical offload-on/off results at `f19ebc5b1da1c9b0075eecfd2f93fc6ca4b3ba8d`, before this change, used the same sequence, microbatch count and graph settings:

| Model | Allocated-peak change | Reserved reduction, paired median [range] | Step-time increase, paired median [range] |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Qwen3.5-0.8B, 24 text blocks | +512 bytes | 444 MiB [442, 446] | +21.00% [20.68%, 21.11%] |
| GDN2, 8 blocks | approximately +1 MiB | 258 MiB [248, 286] | +96.45% [96.05%, 96.66%] |

These are measurements of `f19ebc5b1`, not the adjusted GDN2 implementation. The earlier four-block stack at `043e3173451bea74e63c02b197867bf356ad72e9` saved 192 MiB allocated (16.88%) with +58.42% runtime; it excluded vocabulary loss, optimizer updates and CUDA graphs ([raw evidence](https://github.com/Pinoeer-kingxi/Megatron-LM/tree/34371ca51fa2dffb5c362f1c52c89b1801670226/gdn-followup-20261016)).

The option remains disabled by default. Upstream GPU CI, four-card GDN2 composition, pretrained GDN2 and a continuous 200-step graph run are not covered.

## Issue tracking

Related to #6757.

## Contribution process

### Pre-checks

- [x] I have added relevant unit tests.
- [ ] I have added relevant functional tests.
- [x] The existing GDN determinism-manifest association covers this dispatch; the coverage checker passes. No numerical kernel changes are included.
- [x] I have added proper typing to the changed code.
- [x] I have added relevant documentation and reproducible commands.
- [x] I have run Black, isort, Ruff and the project Pylint rules on the changed Python files.

+# GDN recurrence activation offloading
+
+`gdn_core_attn` offloads tensors saved by BF16/FLA GatedDeltaNet and GatedDeltaNet2 recurrences.
+It reuses the existing activation-offload manager, streams and pinned-memory pool.
+The option is disabled by default. Projection and convolution/QKV recomputation
+and convolution-input offload are separate scopes proposed in
+[PR #7852](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/7852).
+
+## Usage and supported configurations
+
+Add these options to an existing GDN training configuration:
+
+```bash
+export NVTE_CPU_OFFLOAD_V1=1
+# Training arguments:
+--bf16 --experimental-attention-variant gdn \
+--fine-grained-activation-offloading --offload-modules gdn_core_attn
+```
+
+The training CLI requires `NVTE_CPU_OFFLOAD_V1=1` with Transformer Engine 2.10
+or newer. Programmatic configurations set `fine_grained_activation_offloading=True`,
+`offload_modules=["gdn_core_attn"]` and `gdn_kernel_backend="fla"`.
+Selective `gdn_norm_out` recomputation and the existing opt-in pre-GDR fusion are
+supported for GDN. GDN2 supports `gdn_norm_out` recomputation and requires FLA's
+`fla.ops.gdn2` kernel. Configuration rejects FP8/FP4, non-BF16 execution, other
+recurrence backends and full-layer recomputation. CUDA graphs require
+`cuda_graph_impl="transformer_engine"`; attention or whole-layer capture uses the
+existing transfer stream/event callbacks. Replay stays on the caller's autograd
+stream to preserve the order of layer graphs sharing a memory pool. Local and
+full-iteration graphs remain unsupported.
+`delay_offload_until_cuda_graph` uses the existing replay flush.
+
+The manager's minimum tensor size, offload fraction and last-group margin apply.
+After warmup, fraction zero selects no transfers. Warmup can still copy eligible
+tensors to collect size statistics. The default minimum is 1,048,576 elements;
+short correctness tests use 1024 elements to exercise copies. Use multiple GDN
+layers when measuring steady-state savings: one GDN group is kept resident after
+warmup. Evaluation, no-grad and fully frozen recurrence execution bypass the scope.
+
+## Saved tensors and integration boundary
+
+Profiling records saved-tensor storage identity, size, save location and first
+backward access. The recurrence saves Q/K/V, gates and its internal WY
+representation. Some saves alias inputs retained by neighboring operations;
+moving one saved reference does not free a storage still used on GPU.
+
+GDN2 keeps differentiable write-gate outputs on GPU because sigmoid backward
+also retains their storage. The erase gate stays on GPU when its heads do not
+need expansion; expanded and frozen gates remain eligible for offloading.
+
+The offload scope wraps only the FLA recurrence. A differentiable recurrence input
+anchors backward prefetch, including a trainable gate when Q is frozen. The scope
+commits on the raw recurrence output, before gated output normalization, so reload
+completes before FLA backward reads its saved tensors. The integration does not
+force-release inputs or break their storage aliases. The output norm and its
+optional recomputation checkpoint remain outside the scope.
+
+The integration preserves the existing pre-GDR kernels, including their
+autotuning and atomic parameter-gradient reductions.
+
+## Reproduce profiling and training checks
+
+Profile a GDN stack, then benchmark disabled and enabled offloading:
+
+```bash
+python -m torch.distributed.run --standalone --nproc-per-node=1 \
+  tools/ssm/gdn_activation_offload.py --mode profile --layers 4 \
+  --hidden-size 1024 --seq-length 4096 --output /tmp/gdn-profile.json
+python -m torch.distributed.run --standalone --nproc-per-node=1 \
+  tools/ssm/gdn_activation_offload.py --mode benchmark --layers 4 \
+  --hidden-size 1024 --seq-length 4096 --fractions 0 0.5 1 \
+  --output /tmp/gdn-benchmark.json
+```
+
+Add `--variant gdn2` to profile or benchmark the GDN2 recurrence. These stack
+benchmarks exclude vocabulary loss and optimizer updates.
+
+The reduced-model test trains complete GDN/attention decoder blocks, embeddings,
+MLPs and vocabulary loss with the native schedules and BF16 Adam. Four ranks
+cover DP, TP, TP+SP, CP, PP, PP+VPP, TP+SP+CP and TP+SP+PP, with GDN's two fusion
+settings and unfused GDN2, both norm-recomputation settings and fractions 0/0.5/1:
+
+```bash
+python -m torch.distributed.run --standalone --nproc-per-node=4 \
+  --log-dir /tmp/gdn-training-ranks --redirects 3 --tee 3 \
+  -m pytest -q tests/unit_tests/ssm/test_gdn_offload_training.py
+```
+
+The TE graph test captures attention or whole layers after three native optimizer
+steps, verifies that graphs were created, then compares three replay steps with
+offloading disabled and enabled. It covers GDN/GDN2, norm recomputation and
+delayed offload on single-stage DP, TP2+SP and PP2 configurations:
+
+```bash
+python -m torch.distributed.run --standalone --nproc-per-node=2 \
+  -m pytest -q tests/unit_tests/ssm/test_gdn_offload_cuda_graphs.py
+```
+
+For a one-GPU check, use `--nproc-per-node=1` and select `-k tp1`.
+
+The optional Qwen tool imports local Hugging Face Qwen3.5-0.8B weights through
+Megatron Bridge and trains all 24 text decoder blocks. Vision and MTP are excluded.
+It requires a Bridge environment with Qwen3.5 VL mappings; the historical runs
+used revision `c860f8a5bc5fddd78690f32baa0b8696774308b4` and the compatibility
+overlay recorded in the evidence. Bridge is not a core runtime dependency.
+
+Give each rank its own persistent Triton cache before starting the training
+interpreter. Concurrent ranks can select different autotuned configurations for
+the same key; sharing a cache can overwrite those choices and make even repeated
+offload-disabled baselines differ. Create the root once for a fixed
+topology/fusion/norm-recomputation setting and reuse it for both comparison arms:
+
+```bash
+# Run once for this comparison; preserve this exported root between arms.
+export TRITON_CACHE_DIR="$(mktemp -d /tmp/qwen-offload-triton.XXXXXX)"
+python -m torch.distributed.run --standalone --nproc-per-node=4 \
+  --log-dir /tmp/qwen-disabled-ranks --redirects 3 --tee 3 --no-python \
+  bash -c 'export TRITON_CACHE_DIR="${TRITON_CACHE_DIR}/rank-${RANK}"; exec python "$@"' \
+  qwen-training tools/ssm/qwen_gdn_offload_training.py \
+  --weights /path/to/Qwen3.5-0.8B --data /path/to/messages.jsonl \
+  --tp 2 --sp --pp 2 --seq-length 128 --min-offloaded-tensor-size 1024 \
+  --warmup 1 --iterations 2 --check-state --output /tmp/qwen-disabled.json
+```
+
+Run a fresh enabled process with the same exported cache root and arguments plus
+`--fraction 1` and a distinct output/log directory. Do not recreate the cache root
+or clear its rank subdirectories between matched runs. Repeat with
+`--recompute-norm` off/on and `--fused-pre-gdr` off/on, using a new root and a
+separate disabled baseline for each fusion/recomputation pair. Keep topology,
+rank mapping and model inputs identical within each pair.
+For unfused pre-GDR, require exact equality of recorded losses, gradient norms,
+all accumulated gradients, updated weights and complete Adam/master-weight state
+on every rank. Fused pre-GDR uses native atomic gate-gradient reductions and can
+differ even between disabled baselines. Its fingerprints can detect differences
+but cannot measure their numerical size; a fused correctness comparison must
+inspect the actual tensors against repeated disabled baselines with explicit
+numerical tolerances.
+Check zero pinned-buffer ownership before native schedule resets; positive
+fractions must select transfers. The supplied JSONL must contain a `messages`
+field accepted by the local tokenizer's chat template.
+
+To check restart behavior, finish a run with `--save-checkpoint /path/to/new-checkpoint`,
+then start a fresh process with `--load-checkpoint /path/to/new-checkpoint`.
+The tool uses Megatron's distributed checkpointing for model parameters, complete
+optimizer/master-weight state and per-rank RNG state. Token windows continue from
+the saved next-step index. Keep the model, data, topology and other training
+arguments unchanged between runs. The offload manager is transient and learns
+its transfer policy again after restart. Compare the resumed states with the
+corresponding steps of an uninterrupted `--check-state` run.
+
+Exact replay assumes the same per-rank tuning choices; independently autotuned
+configurations do not have a global bitwise-reproducibility guarantee.
+[The recorded cold-cache controls](https://github.com/Pinoeer-kingxi/Megatron-LM/tree/8c5cc72379de4e9ef8d80856973dd64f23cc0dac/gpu-20261016)
+include the shared-cache failure and passing isolated-cache runs.
+
+For performance runs, omit `--check-state`, use the default tensor-size threshold,
+warm up three optimizer steps and measure ten, with three fresh-process repeats.
+Compare the same topology and fusion setting on otherwise idle devices. Report
+peak allocated memory and median complete optimizer-step time. Snapshots and
+input preparation are outside measured steps. Short correctness comparisons
+provide no throughput or convergence qualification.
+
+## Results and evidence provenance
+
+Evidence must identify the executed source commit, launcher commands, per-rank
+outputs and exit codes. [The pinned validation bundle](https://github.com/Pinoeer-kingxi/Megatron-LM/tree/6ca000df1d21df1fe042be13f008bd900de1f9b4/restore-upstream-gate-20261016)
+contains the restored-kernel checks and their source identities. CPU checks do not
+qualify GPU training, and earlier fixed-reduction results do not qualify the
+native fused path. [Historical logs, CSVs and reports](https://github.com/Pinoeer-kingxi/Megatron-LM/tree/cf8df32ec2424bcc6c42a5486d2fe68213c74294/split-20261015/historical)
+retain their original revisions separately.
+
+Complete-Qwen measurements at `87c22d1abae13abf375e8ed4ddfe62301cde87f4`
+use one RTX A6000, sequence 4096, four microbatches, fraction 1, the default
+tensor threshold and norm recomputation off. Each fusion setting has three
+fresh-process pairs, three warmup steps and ten timed optimizer steps. Peak
+allocated memory falls by 952 MiB: 3.01% with unfused pre-GDR and 3.04% with
+native fused pre-GDR. Paired median step-time increases are 1.19% (0.87–1.54%)
+and 1.89% (1.35–2.57%), respectively. Input preparation and state snapshots are
+outside the timing boundary. These compare offload on/off within each fusion
+setting; they do not compare the fusion implementations.
+[Raw samples, device telemetry and commands](https://github.com/Pinoeer-kingxi/Megatron-LM/tree/f35f8532de106bcb49c1d9ae7b5dea512567d1e4/current-head-gpu-20261016/performance)
+retain the executed revision and PyTorch/TE/FLA versions.
+
+At `485cb5fa2ffedaaaa0a1a4d095e43ddd99487c1d`, checkpoint comparisons cover
+six continuous steps versus two steps followed by four in a fresh resumed
+process: disabled control and all four offloaded fusion/norm settings on one
+GPU, plus unfused TP2+SP with norm recomputation. Recorded loss, gradients,
+weights and complete optimizer states are byte-identical in these runs.
+A separate 250-step unfused Qwen run at `87c22d1ab`, sequence 2048, has finite
+loss/gradient norms, a stable 72-buffer pinned pool and stable steady-state GPU
+memory; another job overlaps that run, so its timing is not qualified.
+[Checkpoint and stability evidence](https://github.com/Pinoeer-kingxi/Megatron-LM/tree/34371ca51fa2dffb5c362f1c52c89b1801670226/gdn-followup-20261016)

+support and documentation.

+Whole-layer TE graph measurements at

+and a randomly initialized eight-block GDN2/attention model. Both include
+embeddings, MLPs, vocabulary loss and native BF16 Adam. Each model uses one A6000,
+sequence 2048, four microbatches, unfused pre-GDR, norm recomputation off, fraction 1
+and the default tensor threshold. Three fresh-process pairs alternate arm order;
+each arm trains three native steps, captures graphs, then trains three replay
+warmup and ten timed optimizer steps. Input preparation, capture and state
+fingerprints are outside performance timing. The optimizer remains eager.
+
+| Model | Allocated-peak change | Reserved-peak reduction, median [range] | Paired step-time increase, median [range] |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| Qwen3.5-0.8B, 24 text blocks | +512 bytes | 444 MiB [442, 446] | +21.00% [20.68%, 21.11%] |
+| GDN2, 8 blocks, hidden size 1024, vocabulary 4096 | approximately +1 MiB | 258 MiB [248, 286] | +96.45% [96.05%, 96.66%] |
+
+These graph runs reduce reserved memory but show no allocated-peak reduction and
+substantial runtime cost. Evaluate the trade-off on the target workload before
+enabling graph offloading. The pairs hold TE graph mode fixed. Six-step
+correctness runs match losses, gradients, weights and complete optimizer-state
+fingerprints; all performance pairs also match their loss and gradient-norm
+sequences. Pinned-buffer ownership returns to zero before schedule resets and
+pool allocation counters stay constant during replay.
+[Commands, raw timings, rank logs and verification](https://github.com/Pinoeer-kingxi/Megatron-LM/tree/6ec7df0dc5adcd9f704077636398999ebdfea027/gdn-graph-training-20261017)

+the GDN2 live-gate change below; `d18040ba5a` used the same runtime as this source.
+
+Profiling at `d18040ba5a` identifies transfer time without overlapping kernels as
+the main graph-offload cost. GDN2 copies 1600 MiB in each direction per optimizer

+recurrence. At `367d014c7bf74ba3553c9db58da47fa5bcba906e`, keeping live sigmoid
+gates resident reduces each direction to 1440 MiB with unchanged kernel call counts.
+
+Three fresh-process pairs compare the previous and adjusted GDN2 implementations,
+both with offloading enabled and the same whole-layer graph workload above.
+Paired median step time falls by 5.93% (5.89–5.95%); the medians of process-median
+times are 451.71 and 424.91 ms. Peak reserved falls by an additional paired median

+
+At the adjusted source, two ranks each pass 20 scope, 18 native training and nine

+[Transfer traces, paired samples, rank logs and verification](https://github.com/Pinoeer-kingxi/Megatron-LM/tree/a2cd3e9ddc1bfefe92c2a2b4052251c996c16544/gdn-graph-profile-20261017)
+retain exact commands, source identities and the earlier configuration probes.
+
+The earlier GDN2 stack result at `043e3173451bea74e63c02b197867bf356ad72e9`
+saved 192 MiB allocated (16.88%), with +58.42% median runtime. It excludes
+vocabulary loss, optimizer updates and CUDA graphs and remains a separate

+

+select an attention backend for head dimension 256 on A6000. This does not qualify
+new environments or other CP configurations. Local results do not replace
+upstream GPU CI. The checkpoint checks assume the same data, topology and
+configuration. Repeated local data and finite losses do not establish convergence.

+def _forward_step(

+"""Profile GDN saved-tensor lifetimes or compare activation offload with a baseline.
+
+Run with torchrun, one process per GPU. Profiling and timed runs are separate:
+saved-tensor hooks record host-side save/unpack order, not CUDA kernel timings.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import gc
+import importlib.metadata
+import json

+import statistics
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any, Callable
+
+import torch

+from megatron.core import parallel_state
+from megatron.core.models.gpt.experimental_attention_variant_module_specs import (
+    get_gated_delta_net_module_spec,
+)
+from megatron.core.pipeline_parallel.fine_grained_activation_offload import (
+    FineGrainedActivationOffloadingInterface as off_interface,
+)
+from megatron.core.pipeline_parallel.fine_grained_activation_offload import PipelineOffloadManager
+from megatron.core.process_groups_config import ProcessGroupCollection
+from megatron.core.tensor_parallel.random import model_parallel_cuda_manual_seed
+from megatron.core.transformer import TransformerConfig

+
+def build_model(
+    args: argparse.Namespace, offload: bool = False, fraction: float = 1.0
+) -> torch.nn.ModuleList:
+    """Build a stack of real GDN layers with FLA recurrence and TE projections."""
+    config = TransformerConfig(
+        num_layers=args.layers,
+        hidden_size=args.hidden_size,
+        num_attention_heads=args.key_heads,
+        linear_conv_kernel_dim=4,
+        linear_key_head_dim=args.head_dim,
+        linear_value_head_dim=args.head_dim,
+        linear_num_key_heads=args.key_heads,
+        linear_num_value_heads=args.value_heads,
+        normalization="RMSNorm",
+        activation_func=torch.nn.functional.silu,
+        bf16=True,
+        params_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        use_cpu_initialization=True,
+        experimental_attention_variant=args.variant,
+        linear_attention_freq=[1] * args.layers,
+        fine_grained_activation_offloading=offload,
+        offload_modules=["gdn_core_attn"] if offload else [],
+        min_offloaded_tensor_size=args.min_offloaded_tensor_size,
+        activation_offload_fraction=fraction,
+    )
+    groups = ProcessGroupCollection(
+        tp=parallel_state.get_tensor_model_parallel_group(),
+        cp=parallel_state.get_context_parallel_group(),
+    )
+    spec = get_gated_delta_net_module_spec(config)
+    torch.manual_seed(args.seed)
+    model_parallel_cuda_manual_seed(args.seed)
+    return (
+        torch.nn.ModuleList(
+            [
+                spec.module(config, spec.submodules, layer_number=i + 1, pg_collection=groups)
+                for i in range(args.layers)
+            ]
+        )
+        .cuda()
+        .bfloat16()
+    )
+
+
+def forward(model: torch.nn.ModuleList, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Run the GDN stack, preserving the residual between layers."""
+    for layer in model:
+        y, _ = layer(x, None)
+        x = x + y
+    return x
+
+
+def profile(model: torch.nn.ModuleList, x: torch.Tensor) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Record saves, shared storage, and first backward use without retaining extra tensors."""
+    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    phase = "outside_recurrence"
+    input_names: dict[int, str] = {}
+    parameter_storages = {p.untyped_storage().data_ptr() for p in model.parameters()}
+    original_kernels = [layer.gated_delta_rule for layer in model]
+
+    def wrap(kernel: Callable[..., Any], layer_number: int) -> Callable[..., Any]:
+        def call(**kwargs: Any) -> Any:
+            nonlocal phase, input_names
+            phase = f"gdn_core_attn.{layer_number}"
+            input_names = {
+                t.data_ptr(): name for name, t in kwargs.items() if isinstance(t, torch.Tensor)
+            }
+            try:
+                return kernel(**kwargs)
+            finally:
+                phase = "outside_recurrence"
+                input_names = {}
+
+        return call
+
+    def pack(tensor: torch.Tensor) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, int]:
+        index = len(rows)
+        storage = tensor.untyped_storage()
+        rows.append(
+            {
+                "index": index,
+                "phase": phase,
+                "name": input_names.get(tensor.data_ptr(), "internal"),
+                "shape": list(tensor.shape),
+                "stride": list(tensor.stride()),
+                "dtype": str(tensor.dtype),
+                "tensor_bytes": tensor.numel() * tensor.element_size(),
+                "storage": storage.data_ptr(),
+                "storage_bytes": storage.nbytes(),
+                "parameter_alias": storage.data_ptr() in parameter_storages,
+                "save_host_seconds": time.perf_counter(),
+                "first_unpack_host_seconds": None,
+                "last_unpack_host_seconds": None,
+                "unpack_count": 0,
+            }
+        )
+        return tensor.detach(), index
+
+    def unpack(saved: tuple[torch.Tensor, int]) -> torch.Tensor:
+        tensor, index = saved
+        unpack_time = time.perf_counter()
+        if rows[index]["first_unpack_host_seconds"] is None:
+            rows[index]["first_unpack_host_seconds"] = unpack_time
+        rows[index]["last_unpack_host_seconds"] = unpack_time
+        rows[index]["unpack_count"] += 1
+        return tensor
+
+    try:
+        for i, layer in enumerate(model):
+            layer.gated_delta_rule = wrap(original_kernels[i], i + 1)
+        with torch.autograd.graph.saved_tensors_hooks(pack, unpack):
+            y = forward(model, x)
+            torch.cuda.synchronize()
+            forward_done = time.perf_counter()
+            y.float().square().mean().backward()
+            torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    finally:
+        for layer, kernel in zip(model, original_kernels):
+            layer.gated_delta_rule = kernel
+
+    storages: dict[int, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    for row in rows:
+        storage = storages.setdefault(
+            row["storage"], {"bytes": row["storage_bytes"], "save_indices": [], "phases": []}
+        )
+        storage["save_indices"].append(row["index"])
+        if row["phase"] not in storage["phases"]:
+            storage["phases"].append(row["phase"])
+    recurrence_only_bytes = sum(
+        s["bytes"]
+        for s in storages.values()
+        if all(p.startswith("gdn_core_attn.") for p in s["phases"])
+    )
+    return {
+        "forward_done_host_seconds": forward_done,
+        "saved_tensor_bytes_with_aliases": sum(r["tensor_bytes"] for r in rows),
+        "unique_saved_storage_bytes": sum(s["bytes"] for s in storages.values()),
+        "recurrence_only_storage_bytes": recurrence_only_bytes,
+        "rows": rows,
+        "storages": storages,
+    }
+
+
+def snapshot_step(
+    model: torch.nn.ModuleList, x: torch.Tensor, y: torch.Tensor
+) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Copy outputs and gradients after timing, without retaining the autograd graph."""
+    if x.grad is None:
+        raise RuntimeError("Input gradient is missing.")
+    return {
+        "output": y.detach().cpu(),
+        "input_grad": x.grad.detach().cpu(),
+        **{
+            f"grad.{name}": p.grad.detach().cpu()
+            for name, p in model.named_parameters()
+            if p.grad is not None
+        },
+    }
+
+
+def _snapshot_tensors_equal(expected: torch.Tensor, actual: torch.Tensor) -> bool:
+    """Compare values and bytes, preserving rejection of NaN-containing snapshots."""
+    return (
+        expected.dtype == actual.dtype
+        and torch.equal(expected, actual)
+        and torch.equal(
+            expected.contiguous().reshape(-1).view(torch.uint8),
+            actual.contiguous().reshape(-1).view(torch.uint8),
+        )
+    )
+
+
+def benchmark_arm(
+    args: argparse.Namespace,
+    inputs_cpu: list[torch.Tensor],
+    offload: bool,
+    fraction: float,
+    reference: list[dict[str, torch.Tensor]] | None = None,
+) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], list[dict[str, torch.Tensor]]]:
+    """Measure complete steps and compare every replay outside timing."""
+    off_interface.reset_instance()
+    gc.collect()
+    torch.cuda.empty_cache()
+    model = build_model(args, offload, fraction)
+    times = []
+    peak_allocated = []
+    end_forward_allocated = []
+    peak_reserved = []
+    snapshots = []

+        model.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
+        x = input_cpu.cuda().requires_grad_()
+        if offload:
+            off_interface.reset(process_group=torch.distributed.group.WORLD)
+            off_interface.init_chunk_handler(

+            )
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats()

+        # phase synchronization supports diagnostics, but changes runtime overlap.
+        if args.sync_forward:
+            torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        forward_bytes = torch.cuda.memory_allocated()
+        y.float().square().mean().backward()
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()

+        if step >= args.warmup:
+            times.append(elapsed)
+            peak_allocated.append(torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated())
+            peak_reserved.append(torch.cuda.max_memory_reserved())
+            end_forward_allocated.append(forward_bytes)
+        # Every warmup/measured step uses distinct inputs and is checked outside
+        # timing. Identical repeated inputs could conceal stale cached activations.
+        snapshot = snapshot_step(model, x, y)
+        if reference is None:
+            snapshots.append(snapshot)
+        else:
+            expected = reference[step]
+            if snapshot.keys() != expected.keys():
+                raise RuntimeError(f"Gradient coverage differs at step {step}.")
+            mismatches = [
+                name
+                for name in expected
+                if not _snapshot_tensors_equal(expected[name], snapshot[name])
+            ]
+            if mismatches:
+                raise RuntimeError(
+                    f"Offload changed outputs/gradients at step {step}: {mismatches}"
+                )
+        if offload:
+            pool = PipelineOffloadManager.get_instance().cpu_tensor_pool
+            in_use = pool.get_pool_status()["global_stats"]["current_in_use"]
+            if in_use:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"Pinned buffers remain in use after step {step}: {in_use}")
+        del snapshot
+        del x, y
+    manager = PipelineOffloadManager.get_instance() if offload else None
+    result = {
+        "offload": offload,
+        "fraction": fraction,
+        "step_ms": times,
+        "median_step_ms": statistics.median(times),
+        "peak_allocated_bytes": peak_allocated,
+        "peak_reserved_bytes": peak_reserved,
+        "end_forward_allocated_bytes": end_forward_allocated,
+        "selected_offload_bytes": manager.offload_summary_bytes if manager else {},
+        "steady_offloaded_groups": (
+            sum(
+                g.offload and g.total_offload_bytes > 0
+                for c in manager._cached_chunks_forward
+                for g in c.offload_groups
+            )
+            if manager
+            else 0
+        ),
+    }
+    if reference is not None:
+        result.update(
+            bitwise_equal=True,
+            checked_steps=len(inputs_cpu),
+            mismatches=[],
+            max_pinned_buffers_in_use_after_backward=0,
+        )
+    del model
+    off_interface.reset_instance()
+    return result, snapshots
+
+

+def _batches(

+        batch["position_ids"] = (
+            torch.arange(args.seq_length, device="cuda").view(1, 1, -1).expand(3, 1, -1)

+            "samples": samples,
+            "states": states,
+            "offload_status": offload_status,
+            "first_step": first_step,
+            "next_step": step + 1,
+        }
+    finally:
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        off_interface.reset_instance()
+        parallel_state.destroy_model_parallel()
+        torch.distributed.destroy_process_group()
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    """Prepare a local checkpoint/data run or write one rank's training evidence."""
+    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
+    args = _arguments()
+    os.environ["NVTE_ALLOW_NONDETERMINISTIC_ALGO"] = "0"
+    if args.fused_pre_gdr:
+        os.environ["CAUSAL_CONV1D_DETERMINISTIC"] = "1"
+    provider = _provider(args)
+    token_ids = _tokenize(args)
+    result = {
+        "arguments": vars(args),
+        "text_layers": provider.num_layers,
+        "text_hidden_size": provider.hidden_size,
+        "dataset_tokens": len(token_ids),
+        "pipeline_batch_p2p_comm": provider.batch_p2p_comm,
+        "pipeline_deallocate_outputs": provider.deallocate_pipeline_outputs,
+        "pool_verified_before_reset": args.check_state and not args.dry_run,
+        "torch": torch.__version__,
+        "cuda": torch.version.cuda,
+        "gpu_training_run": not args.dry_run,
+    }
+    if not args.dry_run:
+        result.update(_train(args, provider, token_ids))
+    rank = int(os.environ.get("RANK", "0"))
+    output = args.output.with_name(f"{args.output.stem}.rank{rank}.json")
+    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, default=str) + "\n")
+    logging.info("Wrote %s", output)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
